changelog: - **`npm run check:tenant-models` fails CI when an `orgId` model is not registered with the tenant middleware** (#1560). `TENANT_MODELS` in `src/lib/orgContext.ts` is the list the Prisma `$use` middleware consults before it injects the request's org: a model that is missing from it is a silent pass-through, so a row carrying an `orgId` column only *looks* isolated while it is protected by whatever `where` clause someone remembered to write — which is how eight tenant-keyed models stayed unprotected for months. `scripts/check-tenant-models.mjs` parses the `orgId`-bearing models out of `prisma/schema.prisma` and the registered names out of `orgContext.ts` (as text — no import of the server-only TS module, no new dependency) and fails in both directions: an unregistered model, and a registered name that is not a model or no longer has the column, since a typo never matches anything either. Deliberate exceptions live in the script's `EXEMPT` map with a written reason each (`Setting`, whose legacy `orgId = NULL` rows are the global fallback layer; `Organization`, which is the tenant rather than a row inside one), and the eight models awaiting #1559 sit in a `PENDING_REGISTRATION` ratchet that warns on every run and fails once an entry is registered and left behind. Wired into `.github/workflows/ci.yml` next to the sibling guards and documented in `docs/tenant-isolation.md`.
